publication_policy: Original engineering procedures and examples only. No books, raw extraction, source slides, copied figures, or substantial passages in Git. Public accessibility is not a redistribution license.

tooling.mode: text, --no-install-missing; pdftotext and HTML parser; supplementary HTML cleanup and PPTX XML

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
coverage: Failure/ack boundaries, replication, consistency contracts, quorum caveats, ordering, fencing, replay-safe effects and outbox review
not_covered: Full second-edition chapter text, analytics, encoding/schema evolution, stream processing and complete consensus algorithms
books.incomplete_reason: Publisher offers commercial/full-access reading; no authorized full ebook was available in the environment or found for unrestricted processing. Used publisher contents for identity and public author course notes plus listed primary supplements for mechanisms.

books.title: Systems Performance: Enterprise and the Cloud
coverage: USE investigation, OS context, CPU/waiting profiles, benchmark design, resource pressure and original container scenarios
not_covered: Full book, CPU chapter prose, BPF/Ftrace chapters, exhaustive hardware/storage tuning
books.incomplete_reason: Commercial full edition not available; official sample contains Chapter 3 Operating Systems plus front matter/index. Author web documentation supplies performance methods and profiling details. Sample TOC/index entries are not treated as chapter coverage.

books.title: Software Architecture: The Hard Parts
coverage: Chapter 7 service granularity forces; original boundary/migration worksheets with primary supplements
not_covered: Other book chapters, book case studies, full data architecture and saga taxonomy
books.incomplete_reason: No authorized full edition available; used official Thoughtworks-hosted Chapter 7 and primary architecture/outbox articles. Migration procedures are original supplemental guidance, not claimed book content.

books.title: Database Internals
coverage: B-tree/LSM selection, amplification, Bloom filtering, WAL/checkpoint and recovery review
not_covered: Full book, engine implementation, complete distributed algorithms and recovery algorithms
books.incomplete_reason: Commercial publisher edition not available; author landing page and publisher contents do not provide full text. Technical coverage comes from SQLite and RocksDB primary documentation, clearly labeled as implementations rather than a book conversion.

books.title: Computer Systems: A Programmer’s Perspective
coverage: Allocation arithmetic, ownership/lifetime, cache locality, partial I/O and process/descriptor review
not_covered: Full book, processor design, detailed assembly, linking and virtual memory; lab solutions
books.incomplete_reason: No authorized full edition available. Public author companion pages were accessible; guessed 3e sample URL returned 404 and preface/code-file requests were denied. Used public resource descriptions, POSIX and SEI CERT; no restricted instructor files acquired.

books.title: Release It! Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software
coverage: Failure propagation, resource containment, deadlines, retry budgets, idempotency, breaker/bulkhead review and recovery drills
not_covered: Full book, complete stability pattern catalogue and case histories
books.incomplete_reason: Publisher offers paid full edition; official Stability Antipatterns and Hosts excerpts are public. Retry details supplemented by Amazon primary guidance. No complete-book conversion claimed.

books.title: The Art of Multiprocessor Programming
coverage: Linearizable histories, happens-before, races, progress distinctions, ABA and reclamation review
not_covered: Full second-edition text, complete algorithms/proofs, transactional memory and language-specific lock-free implementations
books.incomplete_reason: No authorized full edition available. Direct Elsevier title and ScienceDirect endpoints were denied; publisher catalogue and search metadata confirm edition. Used author-hosted Herlihy/Wing paper and official Java/reclamation documentation; this is original subject coverage.

books.title: Fundamentals of Software Architecture
coverage: Measurable quality scenarios, conditional style selection, coupling and fitness checks
not_covered: Full second-edition chapters, complete style catalogue and leadership/negotiation treatment
books.incomplete_reason: Full publisher edition requires commercial access. Used author companion/pages, a public first-edition-era interview transcript, and ArchUnit docs. Lesson page descriptions were read; videos were not watched/transcribed. Second-edition-specific details beyond contents are not claimed.

books.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
coverage: Abstract Factory applicability/trade-offs, behavioral interfaces/composition, original small family-construction example
not_covered: Full 23-pattern treatment, publisher examples/diagrams, complete pattern relationships
books.incomplete_reason: No authorized full edition available; official Abstract Factory excerpt and author interview were accessible. Other pattern names receive limited orientation, not a complete book conversion.

books.title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach
coverage: All eight author slide decks processed; selected original procedures on delay/BDP, application/transport contracts, forwarding/routing, LAN/wireless and network security diagnosis
not_covered: Full textbook prose/exercises, diagrams/animations and complete routing/wireless/security implementations
books.incomplete_reason: No authorized full textbook available; official ninth-edition slides are public. PPTX unsupported by book-to-skill, so ordered XML slide text was converted to Markdown then passed through its extractor. Current TCP/QUIC RFCs supplement transport semantics.
